page.overview:
Who is Kebral?

Kebral, played by Greg Vaughan, is the son of Bannak, the leader of the Black Dragon, and the elder brother of Jola in the episode "Debt of the Dragon" from the television series Mortal Kombat: Conquest.

Kebral and Jola had been fighting each to gain their father's respect and the control of the Black Dragon. He was somewhat honor-bound unlike his sister, who was arrogant.

After Bannak was murdered by Jola, who wanted to take the Black Dragon amulet, Kebral became the leader of the Black Dragon. Siro fought and captured him for interrogation as a friend of Siro and Kung Lao was murdered by Jola in order to create conflicts between them. However, Kung Lao freed Kebral.

After returning to the hideout, Kebral learned of his father was killed by Jola, who then kill him with her newly gained power.
